description: The viewpoint is from the curved stone promenade of the harbor on a grey morning, looking along Camogli's famous seafront. The tall pastel houses in rose, ochre, and cream rise in an unbroken wall from the left-center to the right edge, their green shutters closed, while small fishing boats bob on the calm water at the left. The modelled 23 September 2026, 07:46 sky is heavy with cloud over the wooded headland, giving the whole scene a soft, silvery light.
